name: Five Nights at Freddy's Takeover
tagline: Bring Five Nights at Freddy's into the game in the most visible and funny way. The change shows in the first 30 seconds of play.
how_to_play: Survive each night shift from 12 AM to 6 AM as Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy come off the stage to hunt you.
More robots show up every hour, and every zombie in the world turns into a pizzeria robot.
Foxy only sprints while you are not looking at him: stare at him to freeze him.
Robots drop pizza slices and sometimes a Honking Bear Plush: right-click the plush to make nearby robots dance.
The pizzeria appears right next to where you join, and the first night starts a few seconds later.

games.engine: Minecraft Java 26.3 + Fabric Loader 0.19.5 + Fabric API (Java 25, Mojang names)

unlisted_reason: Only playable in the stream demo for now: a player mode for this kit is coming.
